name: Molly guide
author: Brett
description: Molly's narrated walkthroughs (walkthrough@1) in the console: ask her how to do something, or say it to AmberX, and a small floating window shows each step with Next and Previous while the console moves there, highlights it and reads the step out loud. Reaches Molly through the axf.agents@1 capability (the Agent manager provides it); AmberX's server asks her through this plugin's /ask route.
